The files created in January and April of this year correspond to Athens and Seoul, respectively, while the others are from Paris. from datetime import datetime
import os

# Login to file_system
fs_pass=[c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if c['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
login_resp=apis.file_system.login(username='susanmiller@gmail.com',password=fs_pass)
access_token=login_resp['access_token']

base_dir='~/photographs/vacations/'
files=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token,directory_path=base_dir,recursive=False,entry_type='files')
current_year=datetime.now().year

spots={"Athens":[],"Seoul":[],"Paris":[]}
file_meta={}
for f in files:
    meta=apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=access_token,file_path=f)
    created_at=meta.get('created_at')
    dt=datetime.fromisoformat(created_at.replace('Z','+00:00')) if created_at else None
    month=dt.month if dt else None
    year=dt.year if dt else None
    if year==current_year and month==1:
        spot='Athens'
    elif year==current_year and month==4:
        spot='Seoul'
    else:
        spot='Paris'
    spots[spot].append(f)
    file_meta[f]=created_at

print('current_year',current_year)
print('partition_counts',{k:len(v) for k,v in spots.items()})

# Ensure destination directories exist
for spot in spots.keys():
    apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=access_token,directory_path=os.path.join(base_dir,spot),recursive=False,allow_if_exists=True)

moved=[]
failed=[]

dests={spot:os.path.join(base_dir,spot) for spot in spots}

for spot, flist in spots.items():
    dest_dir=dests[spot]
    for src in flist:
        filename=os.path.basename(src)
        dest=os.path.join(dest_dir,filename)
        dest_exists=apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=access_token,file_path=dest)
        try:
            r=apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=access_token,source_file_path=src,destination_file_path=dest,overwrite=bool(dest_exists.get('exists',False)),retain_dates=True)
            moved.append((src,dest,spot))
        except Exception as e:
            failed.append((src,dest,spot,str(e)))

print('moved_count',len(moved))
print('failed_count',len(failed))
if failed:
    print('failed_samples',failed[:5])

# Verify
base_remaining=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token,directory_path=base_dir,recursive=False,entry_type='files')
print('base_remaining_count',len(base_remaining))

for spot in ['Athens','Seoul','Paris']:
    dest_dir=os.path.join(base_dir,spot)
    dest_files=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token,directory_path=dest_dir,recursive=False,entry_type='files')
    print('dest',spot,'count',len(dest_files))
    # print first 3 basenames
    print(' first3',[os.path.basename(p) for p in dest_files[:3]])
